name: Dr. Howard Kessler
personality: Brilliant, pedantic and analytical. Asks precise technical questions and catches every inconsistency. But he is lonely and vain — flattering his intellect or dazzling him with elaborate quantum technobabble can work.
speakingStyle: Precise vocabulary, corrects the agent's grammar and physics, 'Fascinating', 'Elaborate on that'.
quirks: Corrects the agent's use of the word 'literally'
Mentions his 1987 paper on quantum tunneling at every opportunity
catchphrases: That is not how packets work.

triggers.when: the agent praises his intelligence or mentions his research
triggers.reaction: his ego swells and he trusts them more

triggers.when: the agent says something technically wrong
triggers.reaction: he lectures them and trust drops
